title: Smoky Mezcal

items: 1 oz pasteurized egg white or 1 egg white (as written in source)

steps: Rim half a rocks glass with smoked salt. Add egg white, lime juice, agave, Cointreau and mezcal to a shaker. Dry shake for 10 seconds.
Add ice and shake again. Strain into an iced glass and garnish with a lime wheel.
sourceNote: Adapted from Fork & Fire cocktail recipes.
